title: 2019 The Final Roll
about: My final State Arts-In performance and the dive roll I timed by watching another performer's position instead of relying on the musical cue.
description: During my final year as a State Arts-In participant, the show transformed the stage into a shopping mall. In the third-to-last song, three major tricks were performed, and mine was the final one: a dive roll across the stage. Although the music provided an official cue, I had learned that watching Jena's position in the choreography gave me a more reliable signal. When she reached the point I knew by heart, I began my movement and landed the roll on the musical beat. At the time it was simply another carefully timed moment in the show. Looking back, it became a fitting ending to my years as a participant: experience, trust, and one final movement across the stage before that chapter quietly closed.
lyrics: Verse 1
The lights came up one final time,
A shopping mall beneath the shine.
Another show, another song,
Not knowing I wouldn't belong.
So many years behind those scenes,
Painted smiles and in-between.
One last chance before goodbye,
One last moment under lights.
Pre-Chorus
The music had its own command,
Though I trusted something else instead.
Chorus
I watched your footsteps, not the sound,
Knew exactly where you'd come around.
When you reached that place we'd learned by heart,
That's when I'd make my final start.
One last dive across the floor,
One last time forevermore.
I hit the beat without a miss...
Didn't know I'd someday miss this.
Verse 2
Three big moments in that song,
Mine was waiting all along.
Only one would leave the ground,
Flying where the lights were found.
Practice turns to second sight,
Years become a guide that night.
Sometimes trust is quietly earned,
Not from cues, but what you've learned.
Bridge
No one saw the counting done,
No one knew the race I'd run.
Just one roll across the stage...
Closing out another page.
Final Chorus
I watched your footsteps, not the sound,
Found my timing coming 'round.
One last dive before goodbye,
One last moment reaching high.
The music faded, curtains fell,
No one knew the heart could tell.
Some endings never make a sound...
They're just one final roll on the ground.
